data.name: Airaun
data.gender_notes: Airaun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic name 'Ayruhn', meaning 'a mountain of light'. This name is often used for those born under the auspices of the moon and rain, signifying a connection to nature and a strong, radiant spirit. The name Airaun carries the meaning “Mountain of Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Airaun usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Airaun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
